definitions.name: Blinded
definitions.summary: You can't see.
reminders: You automatically fail ability checks that need sight.
Attacks against you have advantage.

definitions.name: Charmed
definitions.summary: Charmed by a creature.
reminders: You can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful abilities or magic.
The charmer has advantage on social checks with you.

definitions.name: Deafened
definitions.summary: You can't hear.
reminders: You automatically fail ability checks that need hearing.

definitions.name: Frightened
definitions.summary: Afraid of a creature.
reminders: The disadvantage applies only while the source of your fear is in sight.
You can't willingly move closer to it.

definitions.name: Grappled
definitions.summary: Held in place.
reminders: Ends if the grappler is incapacitated or an effect moves you out of its reach.

definitions.name: Incapacitated
definitions.summary: You can't act.
reminders: You can't take actions or reactions.

definitions.name: Invisible
definitions.summary: Can't be seen without magic or a special sense.
reminders: Attacks against you have disadvantage.

definitions.name: Paralyzed
definitions.summary: You can't move or speak.
reminders: Attacks against you have advantage.
Hits against you from within 5 ft are critical hits.

definitions.name: Petrified
definitions.summary: Turned to stone.
reminders: Attacks against you have advantage.
Immune to poison and disease; any already in you is suspended.

definitions.name: Poisoned
definitions.summary: Sickened by poison.

definitions.name: Prone
definitions.summary: Lying on the ground.
reminders: Standing up costs half your speed.
Melee attacks against you from within 5 ft have advantage; other attacks have disadvantage.

definitions.name: Restrained
definitions.summary: Held fast.
reminders: Attacks against you have advantage.

definitions.name: Stunned
definitions.summary: Reeling and barely able to act.
reminders: Attacks against you have advantage.
You can speak only falteringly.

definitions.name: Unconscious
definitions.summary: Out cold.
reminders: Attacks against you have advantage.
Hits against you from within 5 ft are critical hits.
You drop what you're holding.

definitions.name: Exhaustion
definitions.summary: Levels stack; each adds to the ones before.
reminders: A long rest with food and drink removes one level.
Level 6 is death.
levelNotes: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws

definitions.name: Bless
definitions.summary: +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

definitions.name: Bane
definitions.summary: -1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

definitions.name: Guidance
definitions.summary: +1d4 to one ability check of your choice, then it ends.

when.text: one check; remove Guidance after using it

definitions.name: Haste
definitions.summary: +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, speed doubled, one extra action each turn.
reminders: Your extra action each turn: one weapon attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object. Use it from Actions.

actions.name: Hasted action
actions.note: One weapon attack (not a full Attack action), Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object.

definitions.endNote: you can't move or take actions until after your next turn, as a wave of lethargy sweeps over you.

definitions.name: Slow
definitions.summary: -2 AC and Dexterity saves, half speed, no reactions.
reminders: No reactions. An action or a bonus action on your turn, not both. At most one attack.
Spells with a casting time of 1 action may be delayed (d20 of 11+ to cast now).

definitions.name: Shield
definitions.summary: +5 AC, no damage from Magic Missile.
reminders: Remove it at the start of your next turn.

definitions.name: Shield of Faith
definitions.summary: +2 AC.

definitions.name: Mage Armor
definitions.summary: AC 13 + Dexterity while not wearing armor. 8 hours.
reminders: Ends if you put on armor.

definitions.name: Hunter's Mark
definitions.summary: +1d6 weapon damage against the marked target.

when.text: only against the marked target

reminders: Advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find the marked target.
Bonus action to move the mark when the target drops to 0 HP.

definitions.name: Hex
definitions.summary: +1d6 necrotic damage against the cursed target.

when.text: only against the cursed target

reminders: The target has disadvantage on checks with the ability you chose.

choice.label: Ability: the target has disadvantage on its checks

definitions.name: Heroism
definitions.summary: Immune to frightened; temp HP each turn.
reminders: At the start of each of your turns, gain temp HP equal to the caster's spellcasting modifier.

definitions.name: Aid
definitions.summary: +5 HP maximum (more if upcast) for 8 hours.

definitions.name: Blur
definitions.summary: Attackers that rely on sight have disadvantage.

definitions.name: Faerie Fire
definitions.summary: You glow: attacks against you have advantage.
reminders: Attacks against you have advantage.
You can't benefit from being invisible.

definitions.name: Hold Person
definitions.summary: Paralyzed by magic.
reminders: Wisdom save at the end of each of your turns ends it.

definitions.name: Bardic Inspiration
definitions.summary: Add the die to one attack roll, ability check or saving throw within 10 minutes, even after seeing the d20 (before the DM says how it went). Remove it once you use it.

when.text: once within 10 minutes; the die is then gone
once within 10 minutes; the die is then gone
once within 10 minutes; the die is then gone

definitions.name: Half cover
definitions.summary: +2 AC and Dexterity saves.

definitions.name: Three-quarters cover
definitions.summary: +5 AC and Dexterity saves.

definitions.name: Hexed
definitions.summary: Someone's Hex is on you: disadvantage on ability checks with the chosen ability, and their hits deal you an extra 1d6 necrotic.
reminders: The caster's hits deal you an extra 1d6 necrotic damage.

definitions.name: Invisibility
definitions.summary: Invisible until the spell ends, or until you attack or cast a spell.
reminders: Ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

definitions.name: Greater Invisibility
definitions.summary: Invisible for the duration, even while attacking or casting.

definitions.name: Hunter's Marked
definitions.summary: A ranger's Hunter's Mark is on you: their weapon hits deal you an extra 1d6, and they track you easily.
reminders: The caster's weapon hits deal you an extra 1d6 damage.

definitions.name: Cause Fear
definitions.summary: You're frightened of the caster.
reminders: Wisdom save at the end of each of your turns ends it.

definitions.name: Fear
definitions.summary: Frightened: you drop what you're holding and must Dash away from the caster each turn.
reminders: Drop what you're holding. On your turn, Dash away from the caster by the safest route.
Wisdom save at the end of a turn where you end out of the caster's sight ends it.

definitions.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
definitions.summary: Laughing helplessly: prone and incapacitated.
reminders: Wisdom save at the end of each of your turns (advantage if it was triggered by damage) ends it.

definitions.name: Hold Monster
definitions.summary: Paralyzed.
reminders: Wisdom save at the end of each of your turns ends it.

definitions.name: Sleep
definitions.summary: Magically asleep: unconscious until damaged or someone uses an action to wake you.

definitions.name: Blindness
definitions.summary: Blinded by the spell.
reminders: Constitution save at the end of each of your turns ends it.

definitions.name: Deafness
definitions.summary: Deafened by the spell.
reminders: Constitution save at the end of each of your turns ends it.

definitions.name: Web
definitions.summary: Stuck in the webs: restrained.
reminders: Use your action for a Strength check against the caster's DC to break free.

definitions.name: Entangle
definitions.summary: Grasping plants: restrained.
reminders: Use your action for a Strength check against the caster's DC to break free.

definitions.name: Ensnaring Strike
definitions.summary: Thorny vines: restrained.
reminders: At the start of each of your turns you take 1d6 piercing damage.
Use your action for a Strength check against the caster's DC to break free.

definitions.name: Charm Person
definitions.summary: Charmed by the caster, who you regard as a friendly acquaintance.
reminders: Ends if the caster or their companions harm you. You know you were charmed when it ends.

definitions.name: Command
definitions.summary: You follow a one-word command on your next turn.

definitions.name: Armor of Agathys
definitions.summary: Frosty armor: temporary HP (5 per slot level), and melee attackers who hit you take cold damage while they last.
reminders: While its temporary HP last, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes cold damage (5 per slot level).

onDamage.text: Armor of Agathys: if a melee attack hit you, the attacker takes {amount} cold damage.

definitions.name: Lethargy (after Haste)
definitions.summary: Haste has ended: you can't move or take actions until after your next turn.
reminders: You can't move or take actions until after your next turn.

definitions.name: Polymorph
definitions.summary: You're a beast: its statistics, mind included, replace yours until the spell ends or the beast drops to 0 HP.
reminders: You can't speak or cast spells. At 0 HP you change back and extra damage carries over.

definitions.name: True Polymorph
definitions.summary: You're another creature: its statistics, mind included, replace yours. After an hour of concentration it lasts until dispelled.
reminders: At 0 HP you change back and extra damage carries over. Held for the full hour, it lasts until dispelled.

definitions.name: Barkskin
definitions.summary: AC can't be less than 16, whatever armor is worn.

definitions.name: Charm of Sunlight
definitions.summary: Sunlight in a sphere around your crown of light (Daylight variant, 5th level), for 1 hour. Each ally who joined with their reaction adds 10 ft and gets a crown of their own.

definitions.name: Shillelagh
definitions.summary: A club or quarterstaff becomes magical: attacks and damage use the caster's spellcasting ability, and its damage die becomes a d8. 1 minute.

definitions.name: Pass Without Trace
definitions.summary: +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for you and creatures you choose within 30 ft; you can't be tracked except by magic, and leave no tracks.

definitions.name: Aura of Protection
definitions.summary: A paladin's aura (within 10 ft, 30 ft from their 18th level): add their Charisma modifier to your saving throws while they're conscious.

when.text: within the paladin's aura, and the paladin is conscious

reminders: Only while you're within the aura and the paladin is conscious.

definitions.name: Aura of Courage
definitions.summary: A paladin's aura: you can't be frightened while you're within it and the paladin is conscious.
reminders: You can't be frightened.
Only while you're within the aura and the paladin is conscious.

definitions.name: Aura of Devotion
definitions.summary: An Oath of Devotion paladin's aura: you can't be charmed while you're within it and the paladin is conscious.
reminders: You can't be charmed.
Only while you're within the aura and the paladin is conscious.

definitions.name: Aura of Warding
definitions.summary: An Oath of the Ancients paladin's aura: resistance to damage from spells.
reminders: Resistance to damage from spells: mark the damage as from a spell on the HP pad.

definitions.name: Aura of Alacrity
definitions.summary: An Oath of Glory paladin's aura: starting your turn within it gives +10 ft walking speed until the end of that turn.
reminders: Until the end of this turn. Started your turn in the aura again? Add it again.

definitions.name: Aura of the Sentinel
definitions.summary: An Oath of the Watchers paladin's aura: add their proficiency bonus to initiative.
reminders: Only while you're within the aura and the paladin isn't incapacitated.

definitions.name: Aura of the Guardian
definitions.summary: An Oath of Redemption paladin can take damage meant for you, with their reaction, while you're within 10 ft.
reminders: When you take damage, the paladin may take it instead (their reaction).

definitions.name: Aura of Conquest
definitions.summary: An Oath of Conquest paladin's aura: if you're frightened of them, your speed is 0 in it and you take psychic damage at the start of your turns.
reminders: Psychic damage equal to half the paladin's level when you start your turn in the aura.

definitions.name: Aura of Hate
definitions.summary: An Oathbreaker paladin's aura: fiends and undead (and the paladin) add the paladin's Charisma modifier to melee weapon damage.

when.text: you're a fiend or undead within the aura

reminders: Several of these auras don't stack: only the best one counts.

definitions.name: Twilight Sanctuary
definitions.summary: A Twilight cleric's sphere of twilight (30 ft, 1 minute). When you end your turn in it, the cleric may grant you temporary hit points or end a charm or fright on you.
reminders: At the end of your turn in the sphere: 1d6 + the cleric's level temporary hit points, or one charmed or frightened effect on you ends (the cleric chooses).

definitions.name: Vigilant Blessing
definitions.summary: A Twilight cleric's blessing: advantage on your next initiative roll.
reminders: Gone after your next initiative roll.

definitions.name: Eyes of Night (shared)
definitions.summary: A Twilight cleric shared their darkvision: you see in dim light and darkness out to 300 ft for 1 hour.
reminders: Darkvision 300 ft.

definitions.name: Storm Aura (tundra)
definitions.summary: A Storm Herald barbarian's tundra aura: temporary hit points when it triggers (2 at 3rd level, up to 6 at 20th).
reminders: Each time the aura triggers, you gain its temporary hit points (they don't add up).

definitions.name: Shielding Storm
definitions.summary: A Storm Herald barbarian's aura: resistance to the damage of their storm (fire, lightning or cold).
reminders: Only while you're within the raging barbarian's aura.

definitions.name: Spirit Totem: Bear
definitions.summary: A Shepherd druid's bear spirit (30-ft aura, 1 minute): advantage on Strength checks and Strength saves.
reminders: When the spirit appears you gain 5 + the druid's level temporary hit points (add them on Play).

definitions.name: Spirit Totem: Hawk
definitions.summary: A Shepherd druid's hawk spirit (30-ft aura, 1 minute): advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks; the druid can use their reaction to give you advantage on an attack against a creature in the aura.
reminders: Ask the druid for advantage on an attack (their reaction).

definitions.name: Spirit Totem: Unicorn
definitions.summary: A Shepherd druid's unicorn spirit (30-ft aura, 1 minute): advantage on checks to detect creatures in it; the druid's healing spells also heal you.
reminders: When the druid heals anyone with a spell, you regain hit points equal to their druid level if you're in the aura.

definitions.name: Halo of Spores
definitions.summary: A Spores druid's halo (10 ft): you're within it. The druid can use their reaction to deal necrotic damage to a creature that moves into or starts its turn there (Constitution save).
reminders: Only matters if you're the druid's enemy.

definitions.name: Fly
definitions.summary: Flying speed 60 ft for up to 10 minutes; if it ends while you're aloft, you fall unless you can stop it.

definitions.name: Spider Climb
definitions.summary: Climb on walls and upside down on ceilings with your hands free; climbing speed equal to your walking speed, for up to 1 hour.

definitions.name: Gaseous Form
definitions.summary: A misty cloud for up to 1 hour: flying speed 10 ft (hover), resistance to nonmagical damage, advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves; you can't talk, attack or cast spells.
reminders: Resistance to nonmagical damage.
You can't talk, attack, cast spells or handle objects.

definitions.name: Resistance
definitions.summary: Once before the spell ends, add a d4 to one saving throw.

definitions.name: Protection from Evil and Good
definitions.summary: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage on attacks against you; they can't charm, frighten or possess you, and you have advantage on new saves against such effects of theirs.
reminders: Attackers of those creature types have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
They can't charm, frighten or possess you; if they already have, you have advantage on new saves against it.

definitions.name: Absorb Elements
definitions.summary: Resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn; your first melee hit on your next turn deals 1d6 extra damage of that type (more if upcast).

when.text: first melee hit on your next turn

definitions.name: Divine Favor
definitions.summary: Your weapon attacks deal 1d4 extra radiant damage on a hit.

definitions.name: Expeditious Retreat
definitions.summary: You can Dash as a bonus action on each of your turns.
reminders: Dash as a bonus action on each of your turns.

definitions.name: False Life
definitions.summary: Temporary hit points: 1d4 + 4 (+5 for each slot level above 1st). Roll and add them on Play.
reminders: Roll 1d4 + 4 (+5 per slot level above 1st) and add the temporary hit points on Play.

definitions.name: Jump
definitions.summary: Your jump distance is tripled.
reminders: Jump distance ×3.

definitions.name: Longstrider
definitions.summary: Your speed increases by 10 feet.

definitions.name: Disguise Self
definitions.summary: You look different (clothes, armor, gear included); a physical inspection or an Investigation check against your spell DC can see through it.
reminders: Touching or an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC reveals it.

definitions.name: Alter Self
definitions.summary: Pick one: Aquatic Adaptation (gills, swimming speed equal to walking), Change Appearance, or Natural Weapons (1d6, magical, +1 to attack and damage).

when.text: Aquatic Adaptation

reminders: Aquatic Adaptation: breathe water, swimming speed equal to walking.
Natural Weapons: 1d6 bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, magical, +1 to attack and damage rolls.

definitions.name: Darkvision
definitions.summary: You see in darkness out to 60 feet.
reminders: Darkvision 60 ft.

definitions.name: Enhance Ability
definitions.summary: Advantage on ability checks with the chosen ability (Bull's Strength also doubles carrying capacity; Bear's Endurance gives 2d6 temporary HP; Cat's Grace means no falling damage from 20 ft or less).

definitions.name: Flame Blade
definitions.summary: A fiery blade in your free hand: melee spell attacks for 3d6 fire (more if upcast); bright light 10 ft, dim 10 ft more.
reminders: Melee spell attack: 3d6 fire damage.
Bright light 10 ft, dim 10 ft beyond.

definitions.name: Magic Weapon
definitions.summary: The touched weapon is magical with +1 to attack and damage rolls (+2 at 4th level, +3 at 6th). Tick it on that weapon's rolls.

when.text: the weapon you touched
the weapon you touched

definitions.name: Mirror Image
definitions.summary: Three illusory duplicates: when you're attacked, roll a d20 to see if a duplicate is hit instead (6+ with three, 8+ with two, 11+ with one; a duplicate has AC 10 + Dex).
reminders: Attacked: d20 — 6+ (3 left), 8+ (2 left), 11+ (1 left) hits a duplicate instead; a hit destroys it.

definitions.name: Protection from Poison
definitions.summary: Advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.

when.text: against being poisoned

definitions.name: See Invisibility
definitions.summary: You see invisible creatures and objects, and into the Ethereal Plane.
reminders: You see invisible creatures and objects.

definitions.name: Warding Bond
definitions.summary: +1 AC and saving throws, resistance to all damage; the caster takes the same damage you take.
reminders: Resistance to all damage.
Each time you take damage, the caster takes the same amount.

definitions.name: Blink
definitions.summary: At the end of each of your turns, roll a d20: on 11 or higher you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn.
reminders: End of your turn: d20, 11+ you go ethereal until your next turn starts.

definitions.name: Protection from Energy
definitions.summary: Resistance to the chosen damage type.

definitions.name: Spirit Guardians
definitions.summary: Spirits in a 15-ft radius around you: enemies there have half speed, and one entering or starting its turn there makes a Wisdom save (3d8 radiant or necrotic, half on a success).
reminders: Enemies within 15 ft: speed halved.
Entering or starting a turn there: Wisdom save, 3d8 (half on success).

definitions.name: Vampiric Touch
definitions.summary: Melee spell attack each turn as an action: 3d6 necrotic, and you regain half the damage dealt.
reminders: Action: melee spell attack, 3d6 necrotic; you heal half the damage dealt.

definitions.name: Death Ward
definitions.summary: The first time you'd drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 instead and the spell ends (it also stops one instant-death effect).
reminders: The first time you'd drop to 0 HP, you drop to 1 instead; the spell ends.

definitions.name: Fire Shield
definitions.summary: Warm shield (resistance to cold) or chill shield (resistance to fire); a creature that hits you in melee within 5 ft takes 2d8 fire or cold.
reminders: Melee hit from within 5 ft: the attacker takes 2d8 (fire for the warm shield, cold for the chill).

definitions.name: Freedom of Movement
definitions.summary: Difficult terrain and spells don't slow you; you can't be paralyzed or restrained by magic; 5 ft of movement escapes nonmagical restraints or a grapple.
reminders: Magic can't reduce your speed, paralyze or restrain you.
5 ft of movement: escape a grapple or nonmagical restraints.

definitions.name: Stoneskin
definitions.summary: Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
reminders: Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

definitions.name: Holy Aura
definitions.summary: Advantage on all saving throws, and attacks against you have disadvantage; a fiend or undead hitting you in melee may be blinded.
reminders: Attacks against you have disadvantage.

definitions.name: Foresight
definitions.summary: You can't be surprised; advantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws, and attacks against you have disadvantage.
reminders: Attacks against you have disadvantage; you can't be surprised.

definitions.name: True Seeing
definitions.summary: Truesight out to 120 feet.
reminders: Truesight 120 ft: invisible things, illusions, shapechangers' true form, the Ethereal Plane.

definitions.name: Mind Blank
definitions.summary: Immune to psychic damage, to reading your thoughts and divination, and to being charmed.
reminders: You can't be charmed; divination and mind reading fail on you.

definitions.name: Regenerate
definitions.summary: You regain 1 hit point at the start of each of your turns (10 per minute), and severed parts regrow in 2 minutes.
reminders: Start of each of your turns: regain 1 HP.

definitions.name: Antilife Shell
definitions.summary: A 10-ft barrier around you that creatures other than undead and constructs can't pass or reach through.
reminders: Living creatures can't get within 10 ft of you or reach through the barrier.

definitions.name: Globe of Invulnerability
definitions.summary: Spells of 5th level or lower cast from outside can't affect anything inside the 10-ft barrier around you.
reminders: Spells of 5th level or lower from outside can't affect you.

definitions.name: Glibness
definitions.summary: Treat a Charisma check roll of 15 or lower as 15; magic that would reveal you're lying fails.

definitions.name: Tongues
definitions.summary: You understand any spoken language, and creatures that know a language understand you.

definitions.name: Light
definitions.summary: An object you touch sheds bright light 20 ft and dim light 20 ft more.

definitions.name: Produce Flame
definitions.summary: A flame in your hand: bright light 10 ft, dim 10 ft more; you can hurl it (ranged spell attack).

definitions.name: Searing Smite: next hit
definitions.summary: Waiting for your next melee weapon hit: the target catches fire: at the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, a Constitution save against your spell save DC or 1d6 fire (it or a creature next to it can put the flames out with an action).

when.text: the target catches fire: at the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, a Constitution save against {spelldc} or 1d6 fire (it or a creature next to it can put the flames out with an action).

reminders: Ticked already on your next melee weapon damage roll; once rolled, this tag goes (concentration stays for any lasting part).

definitions.name: Thunderous Smite: next hit
definitions.summary: Waiting for your next melee weapon hit: Strength save against your spell save DC or pushed 10 ft away and knocked prone; the thunder is heard 300 ft away.

when.text: Strength save against {spelldc} or pushed 10 ft away and knocked prone; the thunder is heard 300 ft away.

reminders: Ticked already on your next melee weapon damage roll; once rolled, this tag goes (concentration stays for any lasting part).

definitions.name: Wrathful Smite: next hit
definitions.summary: Waiting for your next melee weapon hit: Wisdom save against your spell save DC or frightened of you until the spell ends; as an action it can make a Wisdom check against your spell save DC to end it.

when.text: Wisdom save against {spelldc} or frightened of you until the spell ends; as an action it can make a Wisdom check against {spelldc} to end it.

reminders: Ticked already on your next melee weapon damage roll; once rolled, this tag goes (concentration stays for any lasting part).

definitions.name: Branding Smite: next hit
definitions.summary: Waiting for your next melee weapon hit: an invisible target becomes visible and the target sheds dim light 5 ft; it can't become invisible until the spell ends.

when.text: an invisible target becomes visible and the target sheds dim light 5 ft; it can't become invisible until the spell ends.

reminders: Ticked already on your next melee weapon damage roll; once rolled, this tag goes (concentration stays for any lasting part).

definitions.name: Blinding Smite: next hit
definitions.summary: Waiting for your next melee weapon hit: Constitution save against your spell save DC or blinded until the spell ends (it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns).

when.text: Constitution save against {spelldc} or blinded until the spell ends (it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns).

reminders: Ticked already on your next melee weapon damage roll; once rolled, this tag goes (concentration stays for any lasting part).

definitions.name: Staggering Smite: next hit
definitions.summary: Waiting for your next melee weapon hit: Wisdom save against your spell save DC or disadvantage on attacks and checks and no reactions until the end of its next turn.

when.text: Wisdom save against {spelldc} or disadvantage on attacks and checks and no reactions until the end of its next turn.

reminders: Ticked already on your next melee weapon damage roll; once rolled, this tag goes (concentration stays for any lasting part).

definitions.name: Banishing Smite: next hit
definitions.summary: Waiting for your next melee weapon hit: if the hit leaves it at 50 hit points or fewer, it's banished (to its home plane if not native, otherwise a harmless demiplane, incapacitated) until the spell ends.

when.text: if the hit leaves it at 50 hit points or fewer, it's banished (to its home plane if not native, otherwise a harmless demiplane, incapacitated) until the spell ends.

reminders: Ticked already on your next melee weapon damage roll; once rolled, this tag goes (concentration stays for any lasting part).

definitions.name: Control Water
definitions.summary: You command water in a cube up to 100 ft on a side: flood it, part it, redirect its flow or make a whirlpool; your action can repeat or change the effect.
reminders: Your action each turn: repeat the effect or pick another.

definitions.name: Control Weather
definitions.summary: You take control of the weather within 5 miles; each change of precipitation, temperature or wind takes 1d4 × 10 minutes, one stage at a time.
reminders: Changes come one stage at a time, 1d4 × 10 minutes each: the weather doesn't turn at once.
